description: Source code for EngineLibrary class managing dynamic loading of audio engine libraries, creating engine instances, and handling configuration via XML files in Android's audio policy framework.

classes.name: EngineLibrary
classes.description: Manages dynamic loading of engine libraries, creating engine instances, and configuration handling.

methods.name: loadApmEngineLibraryAndCreateEngine
methods.description: Loads an engine library with a suffix and creates an engine using an XML configuration file.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::load
methods.description: Static method to load the engine library given a suffix, returning a shared pointer to EngineLibrary.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::~EngineLibrary
methods.description: Destructor that calls close() to unload the library.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::createEngineUsingXmlConfig
methods.description: Creates an engine instance and loads configuration from an XML file with fallback.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::init
methods.description: Initializes the library by dlopen-ing the shared object and resolving symbols.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::createEngine
methods.description: Creates an engine instance using the loaded engine interface.

methods.name: EngineLibrary::close
methods.description: Closes the loaded library and resets function pointers.
